app.name: Sogasho Outdoor Sales & Audit
app.description: Outdoor field sales, performance analytics and audit control for Sogasho.

dashboard.title: dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: The app frame is ready. Sales, stock and performance figures appear here once those phases are built.

designSystem.title: brand check
designSystem.intro: Every colour, font and component below comes from the Sogasho brand kit. Use this page to review the look before business screens are built.

users.title: users
users.name: Name
users.noMobile: No mobile number — cannot sign in
users.temporaryAgent: Temporary agent (signs in with phone + password + SMS code)
users.permanentStaff: Permanent staff (signs in with email + password + SMS code)
users.phoneHint: Somaliland mobile, e.g. 063 412 3456. The sign-in SMS code goes to this number.
users.phoneHintAgent: Temporary agents also sign in with this number. Changing it changes their sign-in.
users.rolesHint: Choose at least one. Agents get "Sales Agent".
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out of everything immediately and cannot sign in until reactivated.
users.confirmReactivate: Reactivate {name}? They will be able to sign in again.
users.confirmReset: Create a new temporary password for {name}? Their current password stops working.
users.passwordBody: Give this password to {name} privately. It is shown only once. They must choose a new one at their next sign-in.
users.createdButNotAssigned: The sign-in account was created, but roles or team could not be saved:
users.leaderHint: Only people with the Team Leader / Supervisor role appear here. To add one: Users tab → ⋯ → Edit → tick Team Leader / Supervisor → Save.
users.noTeams: No teams yet. Add the first team.
users.matrixIntro: What each role may do, and for whose data: own = only their own records, team = their team, city = their city, all = everyone. Super Admin always has everything.

errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.checkFields: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.emailRequired: Enter a valid email for permanent staff.
errors.phoneRequired: Enter a valid Somaliland mobile number.
errors.phoneTaken: Another account of the same type already has this mobile number.
errors.alreadyExists: An account with this email or phone already exists.
errors.teamNotInCity: That team belongs to another city.
errors.ownSuperAdmin: You cannot remove your own Super Admin role.
errors.lastSuperAdmin: At least one active Super Admin must remain.
errors.deactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.leaderRole: The Team Leader must have the Team Leader role.
errors.superAdminLocked: The Super Admin role always has every permission.
errors.teamNameTaken: A team with this name already exists.
errors.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.signInIntro: Agents: use your phone number. Staff: use your email.
auth.verifyIntro: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.verifyIntroNoPhone: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to your phone. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.changePasswordIntro: For your security, replace the temporary password before you continue.
auth.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
auth.inactive: Your account is not active. Contact your Super Admin.
auth.notConfigured: The app is not connected to Supabase yet. Add the Supabase settings to .env.local.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.otpInvalid: That code is not correct. Check the SMS and try again.
auth.otpExpired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
auth.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Send a new code.
auth.otpNoChallenge: No active code. Send a new code.
auth.otpResent: A new code has been sent.
auth.otpRateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again in 15 minutes.
auth.smsNotConfigured: SMS sending is not set up yet. Contact your Super Admin.
auth.smsFailed: We could not send the SMS. Try again in a moment.
auth.smsNoPhone: There is no mobile number on your account, so we cannot send your code. Ask your Super Admin to add one.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordNeedsLetter: The password must contain at least one letter.
auth.passwordNeedsDigit: The password must contain at least one number.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordSameAsOld: Choose a password different from the temporary one.
auth.passwordRejected: This password was not accepted. Choose a stronger one.

settings.title: settings
settings.name: Name
settings.inactiveHint: Inactive values stay on old records but cannot be chosen for new ones.
settings.readOnly: You can view these values. Only a Super Admin can change them.

hints.temp_base_salary: One flat monthly amount for every temporary agent (no pro-rating, D-08).
hints.incentive_threshold: Incentive = MAX(0, eligible units − this number) × rate.
hints.incentive_rate: Paid for each eligible unit above the threshold.
hints.payroll_cutoff_day: Day of the next month after which a payroll month can be finalized (1–28).
hints.free_month_amount: Amount recorded for a free-month sale.
hints.allowed_phone_prefixes: Comma-separated, e.g. 063, 065. Leave empty to accept any Somaliland mobile number.
hints.performance_target_units: Agents at or above this number are "Target met".
hints.performance_baseline_units: Agents from this number up to the target are "Baseline"; below it, "Underperforming". Must be lower than the target.
hints.week_start_day: First day of the week in weekly reports and charts.
hints.weekend_days: Not counted as working days for leave.
hints.otp_enabled: When on, every user enters a 6-digit SMS code after their password. Turn off only in an emergency.

settings.branchesIntro: Branches are where agents hand in the money they collect. The branch is chosen on each sale (D-31).
settings.districtsIntro: Districts appear on the sales form for the agent's city. Area is typed freely on the sale.
settings.noDistricts: No districts yet. Add the districts for each city before go-live.
settings.customerTypesIntro: The codes New and Retention are fixed because sale rules depend on them; you can change how they are named.
settings.stockItemsIntro: Equipment tracked by serial number. Codes are fixed; you can change the display name.
settings.holidaysIntro: Public holidays are not counted as working days for leave.

errors.nameTaken: That name is already used in this city.
errors.dateTaken: There is already a holiday on that date.
errors.invalidValue: That value is not allowed. Check the hint under the field.
errors.bandOrder: Baseline must be lower than the target.
errors.priceOverlap: Another price for this plan already covers some of these dates. End the old price first.
errors.productInactive: This product is inactive. Activate it before adding a price.
errors.invalidPrice: Enter a recharge above 0 and an installation fee of 0 or more, with at most 2 decimals.
errors.invalidDates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.planInactive: This plan (or its product) is inactive. Activate it before adding a price.
errors.invalidPlan: Check the speeds: download and upload must be at least 1 Mbps.

products.title: products & plans
products.productsIntro: The services sold by the Outdoor team. Each product has plans. The code never changes once created.
products.plansIntro: Each sale records the product and the plan, and keeps the recharge and installation fee in force on the sale date (D-34). One price for all cities.
products.priceHistoryIntro: To change a price: give the old price an end date, then add the new price starting the next day. Old sales keep their price.
products.codeHint: Capital letters, digits or _; cannot be changed later.
products.name: Name
products.dataHint: e.g. Unlimited or 100 GB. Empty = Unlimited.
products.productFixed: The product of an existing plan cannot be changed.
products.toHint: Leave empty if the price has no end date yet.
products.noPlans: No plans for this product yet.
products.readOnly: You can view products and plans. Only users with "Manage products and prices" can change them.

stock.title: stock
stock.overviewIntro: Stock is counted by quantity (no serial numbers, D-35). The Stock Officer issues stock to an Outdoor Supervisor; it counts for the Supervisor's team once the Supervisor (or Super Admin) accepts it. Each sale by the team takes the chosen items from that stock.
stock.toAcceptIntro: Check the items arrived, then accept. Only accepted stock can be used for sales.
stock.receiveIntro: Stock delivered to the Central Store. Enter the quantity of each item received.
stock.sendIntro: Issue stock from the Central Store to an Outdoor Supervisor. It counts for the Supervisor's team once the Supervisor (or Super Admin) accepts.
stock.returnIntro: Only the Stock Officer records returns, after receiving the equipment.
stock.markFaulty: Put in the faulty store (not usable)
stock.adjustmentsIntro: For lost, damaged or miscounted stock. The Stock Officer requests; Super Admin approves. Nobody approves their own request.
stock.changeHint: Negative to remove (e.g. −2), positive to add.
stock.reportIntro: Per location and item for the chosen dates. Closing = opening + received + transferred in − transferred out − issued to customers + returned in − returned out ± adjustments.
stock.historyIntro: Every stock movement, newest first (last 300). Movements can never be changed or deleted.
stock.sent: Stock issued. The Outdoor Supervisor must accept it.
stock.accepted: Accepted. The stock now counts for the Supervisor's team.
stock.cancelled: Cancelled. The stock is back in the Central Store.
stock.adjustmentRequested: Adjustment requested. Super Admin must approve it.
stock.receivedOk: Stock received into the Central Store.

errors.insufficient: Not enough stock at that location for this quantity.
errors.quantity: Quantities must be whole numbers from 1.
errors.noLines: Enter a quantity for at least one item.
errors.duplicate: Each item can appear only once.
errors.unknownItem: That item is unknown or inactive.
errors.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own request.

stock.noSupervisor: No team has an Outdoor Supervisor yet. Set one on Users → Teams.
